en-US:
Faster, clearer everyday money.
• Log in three taps: amount, a category icon, Save. Your account and most-used categories now sit right under the amount.
• Every category has its own icon across History, Today, Plan and Reports, so a day scans at a glance.
• Set your first budget on one screen: enter a monthly figure and adjust a suggested split.
• Budgets tell you where you stand: On pace, Ahead of pace or Over budget.
• The calendar marks spending, income and scheduled days before you tap.
• New books start with a simple two-step checklist on Today.
• Log a purchase in another currency at the rate you were charged. History filters sit on one row, and Assets group accounts by currency.
• Import CSV, XLSX and JSON with local previews and field mapping, and choose optional account and category presets.
• Widget captures open straight in Log after unlock, and recent entries fill the form in one tap.
• Optional one-time tips support independent development; all core features remain free.
zh-Hans:
日常记账，更快更清楚。
• 三步记一笔：输入金额、点分类图标、保存。账户和常用分类就在金额下方。
• 每个分类都有专属图标，明细、今日、规划与报表一眼可辨。
• 一个页面设好第一个预算：输入月度金额，按建议比例微调即可。
• 预算进度直接告诉你：进度正常、花得偏快或已超支。
• 日历直接标出有支出、收入和计划的日子。
• 新账本在今日页有两步入门清单。
• 外币消费可按实际扣款汇率记录；明细筛选收在一行；资产按币种分组。
• 支持导入 CSV、XLSX 和 JSON，提供本机预览与字段对应；可选账户与分类清单。
• 小组件记录解锁后直接进入记账页，最近条目一键填入。
• 可自愿一次性支持独立开发，所有核心功能继续免费。
